correctness.rationale: For every q a prime power (including 2) and n>=1 in the FULL U_n(q), convolution by the central Steinberg idempotent K(g)=D St(g^-1)/|G| has sharp l1 and linfty norm sum |K(g)|. The standard Steinberg value theorem restricts the normalized absolute class sum to semisimple classes weighted |C(g)|_p/|C(g)|. Eigenvalue orbits under lambda -> lambda^(-q) have N_d=1/d sum_{e|d}mu(d/e)(q^e-(-1)^e); odd d centralizer U_m(q^d) and even d GL_m(q^d) give 1/product_j(q^(dj)-(-1)^(dj)). Product of independent orbit multiplicities yields H_q formal coefficients. Using sum_{d|k}dN_d=q^k-(-1)^k factors H_q=(1+z/q)R_q/(1-z). The tail of log R_q is summable for |z|<sqrt(q), so each coefficient converges to positive C_q at O_{q,rho}(rho^-n) for 1<rho<sqrt(q). One must not replace the external Steinberg theorem by numerical checks.
